Liquipedia API responses (`action=parse`, `formatversion=2`) for the FURIA, Legacy
and MIBR team pages, captured 2026-10-15. `text` is trimmed to a team-infobox
marker plus the Upcoming Matches section, with images removed. Title and page ID
are unchanged. No cookies, scripts or credentials.

FURIA and Legacy both list their derby (Thunderpick World Championship 2026,
Group B winners match); MIBR lists MIBR vs BC.Game (Stake Pulse Beat III).
